Name: American Red Cross | Massachusetts Region
Summary_EN: The American Red Cross offers free disaster assistance, including shelter, food, and clothing, for individuals and families displaced by emergencies. They also provide free smoke alarm installation and fire safety information for homes. For military members, veterans, and their families, services include emergency messages, financial aid referrals, and free resiliency workshops.
Summary_ES: La Cruz Roja Americana ofrece asistencia gratuita en casos de desastre, incluyendo refugio, alimentos y ropa, para individuos y familias desplazadas por emergencias. También instalan alarmas de humo gratuitas y proporcionan información de seguridad contra incendios para hogares. Para miembros militares, veteranos y sus familias, los servicios incluyen mensajes de emergencia, referencias de ayuda financiera y talleres de resiliencia gratuitos.
Programs: Home Fire Campaign: Free smoke alarm installation, fire safety information.; Disaster Services: Immediate aid (shelter, food, clothing) after disasters.; Boston Food Pantry: Free food, fresh produce, SNAP outreach.; Service to the Armed Forces: Emergency messages, financial aid for military.; Resiliency Workshops: Free workshops for military life stress.; Restoring Family Links & International Tracing: Reconnecting families separated by conflict/disaster.; International Humanitarian Law: Courses on humanitarian principles, Geneva Conventions.; Be Red Cross Ready Training: Preparedness education for adults and youth.; Hands-Only CPR: Teaches basic CPR techniques.; Training Services and Certification: Courses for CPR, First Aid, Lifeguarding.; Blood Donation: Donate blood, platelets, plasma.
Who_It_Serves: Individuals and families displaced by disasters; those needing smoke alarms; all households for food pantry; US military members, their families, and veterans; refugee and immigrant communities; adults and older youth for preparedness training.
Cost: Free for disaster assistance, smoke alarm installation, Boston Food Pantry, and resiliency workshops.
Languages: Emergency app, Hero Care app, First Aid app available in English and Spanish. Smoke alarm information available in Spanish.
How_To_Start: Call (800) 564-1234 for disaster assistance or free smoke alarm installation. Visit the Boston Food Pantry in person during open hours to register. For military services, call (877) 272-7337.
Evidence: All disaster assistance is free, provided through the generosity of the American public. || The Red Cross and its partners can test existing smoke alarms and install free smoke alarms for those that need them.
Hours_On_Site: Disaster assistance and military services available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Boston Food Pantry open Wednesdays and Saturdays, 9:00am-12:00pm.
Reviewer_Notes: Removed the Boston Food Pantry sentence (not useful for Lawrence).

Name: Children's Friend and Family Services- a division of JRI
Summary_EN: Children's Friend and Family Services - Lawrence Clinic offers outpatient mental health counseling, individual, family, and group therapy for emotional, behavioral, and developmental issues. They also provide In-Home Therapy and Therapeutic Mentoring. Services are for all ages, including youth ages 3-24 for specific programs like Trauma-Focused CBT and Adolescent Community Reinforcement Approach. They accept various insurances, including Mass Health, private insurance, and funding from DCF and DMH.
Summary_ES: Children's Friend and Family Services - Lawrence Clinic ofrece consejería de salud mental ambulatoria, terapia individual, familiar y grupal para problemas emocionales, conductuales y de desarrollo. También brindan Terapia en el Hogar y Tutoría Terapéutica. Los servicios son para todas las edades, incluyendo jóvenes de 3 a 24 años para programas específicos como Trauma-Focused CBT y Adolescent Community Reinforcement Approach. Aceptan varios seguros, incluyendo Mass Health, seguros privados y fondos de DCF y DMH.
Programs: Outpatient mental health counseling: for emotional, behavioral, developmental issues; Individual counseling: one-on-one therapy; Family therapy: therapy for families; Group counseling: therapy in a group setting; Psychopharmacology: medication management when needed; Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT): for ages 3-18 with trauma; Sensory Motor Arousal Regulation Treatment (SMART): uses play for youth's emotional regulation; Attachment, Self-Regulation, and Competency (ARC): for youth and families with trauma; The Coping Cat Curriculum: for children ages 7-13 with anxiety; Adolescent Community Reinforcement Approach (ACRA): for youth ages 12-24 with substance use; Family Support and Training: one-to-one support for parents/caregivers; Horticultural Therapy: therapeutic spaces using plants; Expressive Therapies: uses art, music, movement; Nature-Infused Therapy: incorporates time outside and therapy dogs; Mind-Body Approaches: includes yoga, mindfulness, meditation; In-Home Therapy: intensive home-based support; Therapeutic Mentoring: one-to-one support for children and adolescents
Who_It_Serves: Individuals of all ages struggling with emotional, behavioral, and developmental issues, and their families.
Cost: Accepts Massachusetts Behavioral Health Plan (MBHP), BMC (Beacon) Mass Health, Beacon (Fallon) Mass Health, Beacon (Carelon), Optum, Tufts-Harvard Pilgrim, Wellsense Blue Cross Blue Shield (B/X), private insurance, and funding from DCF and DMH.
How_To_Start: Referrals are open to anyone. Fill out an online form or call the JRI Navigator.
Evidence: Our clinicians are skilled in addressing conditions such as depression, anxiety, trauma, and behavioral challenges, using evidence-based approaches like ARC and Trauma-Focused CBT. || JRI community-based services programs use the Attachment, Regulation, and Competency (ARC) framework, an evidence-based trauma-informed approach.

Name: City of Lawrence
Summary_EN: The City of Lawrence provides emergency, safety, and disaster help, along with assistance for heating and utility bills. Residents can also find job search help, city hall services, and various recreation and after-school programs.
Summary_ES: La Ciudad de Lawrence ofrece ayuda de emergencia, seguridad y desastres, además de asistencia con facturas de calefacción y servicios públicos. Los residentes también pueden encontrar ayuda para la búsqueda de empleo, servicios del ayuntamiento y diversos programas recreativos y extraescolares.
Programs: After-School & Teen Programs; City Hall Services; Emergency, Safety & Disaster Help; Heating & Utility Bill Help; Job Search Help; Recreation Programs; Voting & Elections
Hours_In_Dashboard: Mon 8:30 AM–4:30 PM; Tue 8:30 AM–7 PM; Wed–Thu 8:30 AM–4:30 PM; Fri 8:30 AM–1:30 PM
Reviewer_Notes: Drafted from the service list only. A city government is too broad for one card: consider listing the specific departments residents use.

Name: EforAll
Summary_EN: EforAll helps people start and grow small businesses in Lawrence through a free business accelerator that combines practical business training, one-on-one mentorship from local business and community leaders, and connections to professional networks. Its Spanish-language program, EparaTodos, runs twice a year in Lawrence. EparaTodos also holds Spanish-language pitch contests, open to anyone, where entrepreneurs can test a business idea, win cash prizes, and meet local business owners.
Summary_ES: EforAll ayuda a personas a iniciar y hacer crecer pequeños negocios en Lawrence con una aceleradora gratuita que combina capacitación práctica, mentoría personal de líderes empresariales y comunitarios, y conexiones con redes profesionales. Su programa en español, EparaTodos, se ofrece dos veces al año en Lawrence. EparaTodos también organiza concursos de presentación de ideas en español, abiertos a todos, donde emprendedores pueden validar una idea, ganar premios en efectivo y conocer a dueños de negocios locales.
Programs: Business accelerator: free training, mentorship and networks; EparaTodos: Spanish-language accelerator, twice a year in Lawrence; Pitch contests: open to all, cash prizes
Who_It_Serves: Aspiring and early-stage entrepreneurs, including Latino entrepreneurs
Cost: Free
Reviewer_Notes: Site blocks automated visits; written by Claude from EforAll news pages. Confirm the Lawrence schedule is current.

Name: Elevated Thought
Summary_EN: Elevated Thought offers an "I Am Art. I Am Change. Apprenticeship program" for youth to strengthen their craft and collaborate on public art. A "summer intensive art program" for youth runs for two weeks, Monday to Friday, 9:30 am - 3:00 pm, to expand art knowledge. "After Hours" provides a creative hub and studio space for young and adult creatives, with professional development and mentoring. "The Artist Camp" is a free professional development program for emerging artists, offering a $150 stipend.
Summary_ES: Elevated Thought ofrece un "I Am Art. I Am Change. Apprenticeship program" para jóvenes para fortalecer su arte y colaborar en proyectos de arte público. Un "summer intensive art program" para jóvenes se lleva a cabo durante dos semanas, de lunes a viernes, de 9:30 am a 3:00 pm, para expandir el conocimiento artístico. "After Hours" proporciona un centro creativo y espacio de estudio para creativos jóvenes y adultos, con desarrollo profesional y mentoría. "The Artist Camp" es un programa gratuito de desarrollo profesional para artistas emergentes, que ofrece un estipendio de $150.
Programs: I Am Art. I Am Change. Apprenticeship program: Youth learn craft, collaborate on public art projects.; summer intensive art program: Two-week program to expand art medium knowledge.; After Hours: Creative hub, studio space for artists, professional development.; RWRK sewing & fashion design program: Learn sustainable fashion techniques, create collection.; The Artist Camp: Free professional development for emerging artists, $150 stipend.; Líneas Propias: Sketching Who We Are: Workshop turning personal memories into visual stories.
Who_It_Serves: Youth and artists of color, emerging artists, young and adult creatives.
Cost: Free for The Artist Camp program.
How_To_Start: Apply online or contact for information.
Evidence: ET provides creative access, exposure, and opportunity for youth and artists of color. || After Hours serves as a creative hub and artist studio space that provides programming such as professional development, workshops, one-on-one mentoring with working artists, networking, and more.
Hours_On_Site: office hours: monday - friday | 11 am - 3 pm || program hours: monday - thursday | 3 pm - 6 pm

Name: Eliot Community Human Services
Summary_EN: Eliot Community Human Services offers mental health, substance use, and emergency treatment 24/7 for youth, families, and adults through Community Behavioral Health Centers. They provide intensive, family-centered services for children and youth with serious emotional, behavioral, and mental health challenges, especially for MassHealth families, with services available in Spanish. Adults can access counseling, psychiatry, and medication management for mental health and substance use recovery, accepting MassHealth and most private insurance. Homelessness services include a Safe Haven Shelter for Women, and residential/day services are available for adults with developmental disabilities and brain injuries.
Summary_ES: Eliot Community Human Services ofrece tratamiento de salud mental, uso de sustancias y emergencias 24/7 para jóvenes, familias y adultos a través de los Community Behavioral Health Centers. Proporcionan servicios intensivos y centrados en la familia para niños y jóvenes con desafíos emocionales, conductuales y de salud mental graves, especialmente para familias con MassHealth, con servicios disponibles en español. Los adultos pueden acceder a consejería, psiquiatría y manejo de medicamentos para la recuperación de la salud mental y el uso de sustancias, aceptando MassHealth y la mayoría de los seguros privados. Los servicios para personas sin hogar incluyen un Safe Haven Shelter for Women, y hay servicios residenciales y diurnos para adultos con discapacidades del desarrollo y lesiones cerebrales.
Programs: Community Behavioral Health Centers (CBHCs): 24/7 mental health, substance use, emergency treatment.; Community Service Agency (CSA) Programs: Intensive, family-centered services for children and youth.; Counseling and Psychiatry Services: Therapy, medication management for mental health, substance use.; Safe Haven Shelter for Women: Shelter for women experiencing homelessness.; Day Services (Developmental Disability/Brain Injury): Day programs for adults with developmental disabilities/brain injuries.; Residential Services (Developmental Disability/Brain Injury): Group homes for adults with developmental disabilities/brain injuries.; Juvenile Justice Residences: Residential network for court-involved youth ages 13-21.; Emergency Residence Programs: Safe, homelike settings for children/youth from DCF.; Emergency Services: Mobile psychiatric evaluation, crisis intervention, stabilization.; Intimate Partner Abuse Education Program: Intervention for domestic violence perpetrators.; First Episode Psychosis (FEP): Support for individuals under 35 with psychosis symptoms.; Community Crisis Stabilization: Short-term treatment for adults in mental health crisis.
Who_It_Serves: Youth, families, and adults with mental health, substance use, developmental disabilities, brain injuries, or homelessness.
Cost: MassHealth and most private insurance plans are accepted.
Languages: Services are available in Spanish and other languages when needed.
How_To_Start: Call (800) 988-1111 for emergency support.
Evidence: Eliot offers a wide range of integrated behavioral health and human services for individuals and families, including programs for mental health diagnoses, substance use, homelessness, developmental disabilities, and brain injuries, among others. || Community Behavioral Health Centers (CBHCs) serve as a single entry point for timely, high-quality, mental health, substance use disorder, and emergency treatment for youth, families, and adults, 24/7.

Name: Esperanza Academy
Summary_EN: Esperanza Academy is a tuition-free independent school for girls entering fifth grade who are residents of Lawrence, MA. Families must meet household income requirements for Federal reduced price meals. The school offers fifth-grade admission through an admissions lottery, with limited sixth-grade admission slots. Applications are available in English and Spanish, and a bilingual coordinator can assist.
Summary_ES: Esperanza Academy es una escuela independiente gratuita para niñas que ingresan a quinto grado y residen en Lawrence, MA. Las familias deben cumplir con los requisitos de ingresos del hogar para comidas a precio reducido federal. La escuela ofrece admisión a quinto grado a través de una lotería de admisiones, con cupos limitados para sexto grado. Las solicitudes están disponibles en inglés y español, y una coordinadora bilingüe puede ayudar.
Programs: fifth-grade admission: Admission for girls entering fifth grade; sixth-grade admission: Admission for girls entering sixth grade; Graduate Support: Long-term commitment to students' educational journeys
Who_It_Serves: Girls entering fifth grade, Lawrence residents, meeting federal reduced-price meal income guidelines
Cost: tuition-free
How_To_Start: Download the application (English or Spanish) and follow instructions
Evidence: Esperanza Academy is a tuition-free independent school because we believe that everyone deserves the right to high-quality independent school education. || Applicant’s family must meet household income requirements that fall within or below the income eligibility guidelines for Federal reduced price meals.

Name: Essex County Habitat For Humanity
Summary_EN: Essex County Habitat for Humanity's Critical Home Repair program fixes unsafe or failing parts of homes, including weatherization, energy efficiency and code violations, mainly for elderly or disabled homeowners. To qualify, household income must be at or below 60% of Area Median Income, the home must be owner-occupied, and you must have lived in Essex County for at least a year; homeowners contribute some volunteer hours if able. Its ReStore sells donated building materials, appliances and furniture at low prices.
Summary_ES: El programa Critical Home Repair de Essex County Habitat for Humanity repara partes inseguras o dañadas de la casa, como aislamiento, eficiencia energética y violaciones de código, principalmente para dueños de casa mayores o con discapacidad. Para calificar, el ingreso del hogar debe ser igual o menor al 60% del ingreso medio del área, la casa debe ser su residencia y debe haber vivido en el condado de Essex al menos un año; los dueños aportan algunas horas de trabajo si pueden. Su ReStore vende materiales de construcción, electrodomésticos y muebles donados a bajo precio.
Programs: Critical Home Repair: repairs for low-income, mostly elderly or disabled homeowners; ReStore: discount donated building materials, appliances, furniture
Who_It_Serves: Low-income homeowners in Essex County, especially elderly or disabled
Cost: Repairs made affordable; ReStore discount prices
Hours_In_Dashboard: Lawrence ReStore: Tue–Sat 10 AM–5 PM; Main office: Mon–Fri 8:30 AM–1:30 PM (Danvers; appointments recommended)
Reviewer_Notes: Site blocks automated visits; written by Claude from search results. Our tags also list first-time homebuyer help; check whether the homeownership program is open now.

Name: Family Services of Merrimack Valley/LMCC
Summary_EN: Family Services of Merrimack Valley offers a 24/7 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (988) for mental health distress, available in English and Spanish, with translation for over 250 languages. Free support groups are available for suicide attempt survivors (18+, virtual), loss survivors (18+, in-person in No. Andover), and LGBTQIA+ adults (18+, virtual). The Counseling Center provides professional treatment for mental health challenges. The Family & Community Resource Center offers programs for Greater Lawrence families with children ages birth to 18, including parenting classes and support groups. Young Parents Program supports Greater Lawrence parents up to age 24.
Summary_ES: Family Services de Merrimack Valley ofrece una Línea de Vida de Suicidio y Crisis (988) 24/7 para angustia de salud mental, disponible en inglés y español, con traducción a más de 250 idiomas. Hay grupos de apoyo gratuitos para sobrevivientes de intentos de suicidio (18+, virtual), sobrevivientes de pérdidas (18+, presencial en No. Andover) y adultos LGBTQIA+ (18+, virtual). El Centro de Consejería brinda tratamiento profesional para desafíos de salud mental. El Centro de Recursos Familiares y Comunitarios ofrece programas para familias de Greater Lawrence con niños de 0 a 18 años, incluyendo clases de crianza y grupos de apoyo. El Programa para Padres Jóvenes apoya a padres de Greater Lawrence de hasta 24 años.
Programs: Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: 24/7 support for mental health distress.; Attempt Survivor Support group: Support for individuals over 18 who attempted suicide.; Loss survivor Support group: Support for adults (18+) who lost a loved one to suicide.; LGBTQIA+ Support group: Virtual support for adult (18+) LGBTQIA+ community members.; Counseling Center: Professional treatment for mental health challenges.; Family & Community Resource Center (FCRC): Programs for families with children (birth-18).; Young Parents Program: Support for young parents (up to 24) in Greater Lawrence.; Child Advocacy (CASA): Advocates for children in Essex County juvenile courts.; Question, Persuade, Refer (QPR) training: Learn 3 steps to prevent suicide.; Youth Mental Health First Aid (YMHFA) training: Respond to teen mental health challenges.; ESTEEM: Support for court-involved youth ages 13-18.; Youth Diversion: Case management for young people with first-time offenses.
Who_It_Serves: Residents of Greater Lawrence and Essex County, Massachusetts, including individuals experiencing mental health distress, families with children (birth-18), young parents (up to 24), adults (18+) in suicide support groups, and court-involved youth.
Cost: Free for Samaritans support groups and mental health trainings.
Languages: English and Spanish for the Lifeline, with translation services in over 250 languages available via Language Line Solutions.
How_To_Start: Call 988 for crisis support.
Evidence: Family Services’ Suicide & Crisis Lifeline provides a connection to compassionate, accessible care and support to anyone experiencing any degree of mental health-related distress or suicidal crisis. || Family Services’ Counseling Center provides professional, compassionate treatment to individuals struggling with mental health challenges in individual and group settings, in virtual, hybrid and in-person sessions.

Name: Greater Lawrence Community Boating
Summary_EN: Greater Lawrence Community Boating Program offers a Summer Program with sailing lessons and opportunities to use kayaks, canoes, stand-up paddle boards, and rowboats for all ages. It also has a Counselor In Training Program for members aged 11-16, Private Sailing Lessons, Summer Rowing Programs, and a Competitive Fall Sailing Team. Membership costs are $75 for youth (9-17) and seniors (65+), $150 for adults (18+), and $250 for families. Free lunch is available for members aged 9-18.
Summary_ES: El Programa de Navegación Comunitaria de Greater Lawrence ofrece un Programa de Verano con lecciones de vela y oportunidades para usar kayaks, canoas, tablas de remo de pie y botes de remos para todas las edades. También tiene un Programa de Consejeros en Entrenamiento para miembros de 11 a 16 años, Clases Privadas de Vela, Programas de Remo de Verano y un Equipo Competitivo de Vela de Otoño. Las membresías cuestan $75 para jóvenes (9-17) y personas mayores (65+), $150 para adultos (18+) y $250 para familias. Hay almuerzo gratis disponible para miembros de 9 a 18 años.
Programs: Summer Program: Boating activities and lessons for all ages; Sailing Program: Hands-on sailing lessons for all ages and abilities; Paddle: Use kayaks, canoes, stand-up paddle boards, rowboats; Counselor In Training Program (CIT): Volunteer and training for members age 11-16; Private Sailing Lessons: Individual sailing instruction; Summer Rowing Programs: Rowing activities; Competitive Fall Sailing Team: Fall sailing competition
Who_It_Serves: Residents of the Merrimack Valley, youth and adults
Cost: Youth (age 9-17): $75.00 (includes lunch on weekdays); Adult (age 18+): $150.00; Family: $250.00; Senior (ages 65 and older): $75.00. Scholarships are available. Free lunch program for members 9-18 years old.
How_To_Start: Stop by the boathouse 7 days a week between 8am and 8pm to register.
Evidence: the Greater Lawrence Community Boating Program provides safe, affordable boating opportunities to all residents of the Merrimack Valley. || Youth (age 9-17): $75.00 (includes lunch on weekdays) Adult (age 18+): $150.00 Family: $250.00 Senior (ages 65 and older): $75.00

Name: Groundwork Lawrence
Summary_EN: Groundwork Lawrence offers various programs for Lawrence residents. Through Farmers Markets, Community Gardens, and Costello Urban Farm, residents can access fresh produce, with Farmers Markets accepting SNAP/EBT, WIC, and senior coupons. Free Cooking Classes are also available. The Green Streets program provides free trees to city residents and businesses. Youth can join the Green Team for paid positions or attend Urban Adventures, a free 5-week summer program. Workforce Development offers job training for environmental careers.
Summary_ES: Groundwork Lawrence ofrece varios programas para los residentes de Lawrence. A través de los Farmers Markets, Community Gardens y Costello Urban Farm, los residentes pueden acceder a productos frescos, y los Farmers Markets aceptan SNAP/EBT, WIC y cupones para personas mayores. También hay Clases de Cocina gratuitas. El programa Green Streets proporciona árboles gratis a los residentes y negocios de la ciudad. Los jóvenes pueden unirse al Green Team para puestos remunerados o asistir a Urban Adventures, un programa de verano gratuito de 5 semanas. Workforce Development ofrece capacitación laboral para carreras ambientales.
Programs: Cooking Classes: Learn to prepare healthy meals; Farmers Markets: Access fresh local produce; Community Gardens: Grow food in shared spaces; Costello Urban Farm: Large urban farm for community; Green Streets: Free trees for city residents; Green Team: Paid positions for high school students; Urban Adventures: Free 5-week summer youth program; Workforce Development: Job training for environmental careers; Merrimack Valley Food Resiliency Partnership: Regional effort for food access; Lawrence Pa'lante: Improve transportation, climate resilience; Environmental Education: Programs for K-12 students; Spicket River Cleanup: Community cleanup event
Who_It_Serves: Residents of Lawrence and Greater Lawrence, including youth, K-12 students, high school students, and city businesses
Cost: Farmers Markets accept SNAP/EBT, WIC, senior farmers market coupons, debit, credit, and cash; SNAP households can earn a dollar-for-dollar match up to $80 on eligible purchases. Green Streets provides free trees. Green Team offers paid positions. Urban Adventures is free.
How_To_Start: Call or email for specific programs
Evidence: Groundwork Lawrence provides residents of Lawrence with access to high quality fresh, nutritious produce through the Costello Urban Farm, community gardens, Farmer’s Market, and free cooking courses for themselves and their families. || The Green Streets program works to increase the urban tree canopy in Lawrence by providing FREE trees to city residents and businesses.
Hours_On_Site: Summer Farmers Markets: Every Wednesday from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM at the Campagnone North Common; Every Friday from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Nevins Memorial Library; Every Saturday from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM O’Connell South Common.

Name: Hands to Help
Summary_EN: Hands to Help is Merrimack College's neighborhood resource center, with a drop-in center in Lawrence. It offers after-school tutoring, tax filing help, ESL conversation classes, help with forms, college application support, job preparation and resume building, and an open gym night. College students also deliver meals to local groups and collect clothing and household items for families in need.
Summary_ES: Hands to Help es el centro de recursos comunitarios de Merrimack College, con un centro de atención sin cita en Lawrence. Ofrece tutoría después de la escuela, ayuda para declarar impuestos, clases de conversación en inglés, ayuda con formularios, apoyo con solicitudes universitarias, preparación para el empleo y currículums, y una noche de gimnasio abierto. Los estudiantes también entregan comidas a grupos locales y recolectan ropa y artículos del hogar para familias necesitadas.
Programs: Drop-in center: after-school tutoring, tax help, ESL conversation, form help; College application support; Job preparation and resume building; Open gym night; Meal and clothing drives
Who_It_Serves: Lawrence residents, students and families
Reviewer_Notes: Written by Claude from Merrimack College pages. Our service tags (free clothing, meal packing) don't match: the drop-in center is tutoring/tax/ESL/forms. Fix the tags too.

Name: Jeanne Geiger Crisis Center
Summary_EN: Jeanne Geiger Crisis Center helps adults and children experiencing domestic violence, with a 24/7 hotline (978-388-1888), crisis counseling, short-term transitional housing, and support groups. Its court advocates help people get restraining orders, and legal consultation and representation are offered on a sliding fee scale. It serves Lawrence and about 30 other towns in the Merrimack Valley and North Shore, and runs its Children's Safety Program from an office at 280 Merrimack Street in Lawrence.
Summary_ES: Jeanne Geiger Crisis Center ayuda a adultos y niños que viven violencia doméstica, con una línea de ayuda 24/7 (978-388-1888), consejería en crisis, vivienda transitoria a corto plazo y grupos de apoyo. Sus defensores en la corte ayudan a obtener órdenes de restricción, y ofrecen consulta y representación legal con tarifa según ingresos. Atiende a Lawrence y unos 30 pueblos más del Merrimack Valley y la North Shore, y su Children's Safety Program tiene oficina en 280 Merrimack Street, Lawrence.
Programs: 24/7 hotline: 978-388-1888; Crisis intervention counseling; Transitional housing: short-term; Court advocacy: help obtaining restraining orders; Legal consultation and representation: sliding fee; Support groups; Children's Safety Program: Lawrence office
Who_It_Serves: Adults and children experiencing domestic violence in Lawrence and about 30 nearby towns
Cost: Legal help on a sliding fee scale
Reviewer_Notes: Site blocks automated visits; written by Claude from directory listings. Confirm the Lawrence office address and the services offered there.

Name: Lawrence Community Works
Summary_EN: Lawrence CommunityWorks helps low- and moderate-income residents build financial stability. Its Homeownership Center offers homebuyer seminars, post-purchase and foreclosure prevention classes, landlord training, financial literacy workshops, and one-on-one housing and financial counseling, plus matched savings accounts (IDAs). Movement City, its youth program for ages 10 to 18, combines homework help and college prep with arts, leadership training and mentoring, weekdays 3:30 to 8 PM during the school year, with a summer program for ages 10-13.
Summary_ES: Lawrence CommunityWorks ayuda a residentes de ingresos bajos y moderados a lograr estabilidad financiera. Su Homeownership Center ofrece seminarios para compradores de vivienda, clases después de la compra y para evitar ejecuciones hipotecarias, capacitación para propietarios que alquilan, talleres de finanzas y consejería personal de vivienda y finanzas, además de cuentas de ahorro con aporte igualado (IDAs). Movement City, su programa juvenil para jóvenes de 10 a 18 años, combina ayuda con tareas y preparación para la universidad con arte, liderazgo y mentoría, de lunes a viernes de 3:30 a 8 PM durante el año escolar, con un programa de verano para edades de 10 a 13.
Programs: Homeownership Center: homebuyer, post-purchase, foreclosure prevention, landlord classes; Financial counseling and literacy workshops; Individual Development Accounts: matched savings; Movement City: youth program ages 10-18, weekdays 3:30-8 PM; Movement City summer program: ages 10-13
Who_It_Serves: Low- and moderate-income Lawrence residents; youth ages 10-18
Reviewer_Notes: Site is mostly JavaScript; written by Claude from GuideStar, which can be years out of date. Confirm Movement City hours/ages and that the IDA program still runs.

Name: Lawrence General Hospital
Summary_EN: Lawrence General Hospital, now Merrimack Health Lawrence Hospital, offers a wide range of medical services. These include Emergency Care (a Level III Trauma Center, Stroke Center, and SANE program for sexual assault victims, plus emergency mental health care), Cancer Care, Heart & Vascular services, and Joint Replacement for knees, hips, or upper extremities. They also provide Maternity Care, including prenatal and postpartum education for Merrimack Valley-area mothers and babies. Interpreter Services are available to assist patients.
Summary_ES: Lawrence General Hospital, ahora Merrimack Health Lawrence Hospital, ofrece una amplia gama de servicios médicos. Estos incluyen Emergency Care (un centro de trauma Nivel III, Stroke Center y programa SANE para víctimas de agresión sexual, además de atención de salud mental de emergencia), Cancer Care, servicios de Heart & Vascular y Joint Replacement para rodillas, caderas o extremidades superiores. También brindan Maternity Care, incluyendo educación prenatal y posparto para madres y bebés del área de Merrimack Valley. Hay Interpreter Services disponibles para ayudar a los pacientes.

Los servicios de transporte están disponibles para estudiantes elegibles de K-6 y estudiantes de secundaria, y para estudiantes con discapacidades. Name: Lawrence YMCA
Summary_EN: The Lawrence YMCA (40 Lawrence Street, 978-686-6191) offers child care and early education for preschoolers and pre-K children, with before- and after-school care. Members can use the pool for swim lessons and open swim, plus a fitness center and gym. Teens can join the teen center and programs like Adelante Scholars, Yo Puedo, and Teen Achievers, which support school success and leadership.

Los miembros pueden usar la piscina para clases de natación y nado libre, además del gimnasio y el centro de ejercicio. Summary_EN: Merrimack Valley Dream Center offers several free programs. The Mobile Food Pantry provides free grocery bags monthly to under-resourced individuals and families in housing projects. Shuttle Ministry provides weekend rides to church for those without transportation, and Celebrate Recovery uses 12 steps for freedom from hurts and habits. All programs are free of charge.
Summary_ES: Merrimack Valley Dream Center ofrece varios programas gratuitos. Fresh Start Mobile Showers & Laundry Services ofrece duchas calientes, lavandería, artículos de tocador y artículos esenciales para residentes sin hogar en Haverhill y Lawrence. El Bridge Ministry entrega almuerzos en bolsas y artículos esenciales como calcetines y gorros a personas en dificultades los sábados. Shuttle Ministry ofrece viajes de fin de semana a la iglesia para quienes no tienen transporte, y Celebrate Recovery utiliza 12 pasos para liberarse de heridas y hábitos. Todos los programas son gratuitos.

Name: Northeast Justice Center
Summary_EN: Northeast Legal Aid and Northeast Justice Center offer free civil legal services to low-income individuals, elders, and families in northeast Massachusetts. They provide legal assistance for various issues, including help for low-income taxpayers with IRS controversies through their Low Income Taxpayer Clinic. También hay asistencia legal disponible para miembros de la comunidad camboyano-americana, con información en jemer. Name: Bellesini Academy
Summary_EN: Bellesini Academy is a tuition-free private school for students in Lawrence, Massachusetts. It offers a rigorous academic curriculum, after-school activities, evening study sessions, and a summer enrichment program. Students entering 5th grade (limited 6th/7th) who meet low-income federal guidelines are eligible. The school also provides an Alumni Support Program for graduates. Families support the school through volunteer hours and an activity fee.
Summary_ES: Bellesini Academy es una escuela privada gratuita para estudiantes en Lawrence, Massachusetts. Ofrece un currículo académico riguroso, actividades después de la escuela, sesiones de estudio nocturnas y un programa de enriquecimiento de verano. Son elegibles los estudiantes que ingresan a 5º grado (espacios limitados para 6º/7º) y cumplen con los requisitos federales de bajos ingresos. Name: Beyond Soccer
Summary_EN: Beyond Soccer offers year-round soccer and futsal programs, summer camps, and in-school enrichment for Lawrence youth ages 4-24. Programs include academic support like tutoring and college readiness, and Health & Wellness with fitness, nutrition education, and cooking courses. Youth can also participate in leadership roles through Youth Jobs and Jr. coaching. Some summer programs, like Summer Nights, are no-cost.
Summary_ES: Beyond Soccer ofrece programas de fútbol y futsal durante todo el año, campamentos de verano y enriquecimiento escolar para jóvenes de Lawrence de 4 a 24 años. Los programas incluyen apoyo académico como tutorías y preparación universitaria, y Salud y Bienestar con clases de fitness, educación nutricional y cursos de cocina. Los jóvenes también pueden participar en roles de liderazgo a través de Youth Jobs y entrenamiento juvenil. Algunos programas de verano, como Summer Nights, son sin costo.

Name: Bread and Roses Housing
Summary_EN: Bread & Roses Housing, in partnership with CAF, offers several programs. The Homebuyer Education Program provides an 8-hour course and one-on-one counseling for low to moderate income families to buy a house. The Local Consumer Protection Program helps residents of specific towns resolve disputes with businesses. The Nueva Esperanza Program offers weekly virtual workshops for elders on health and English. Workforce Development includes Digital Literacy, CDL Class B training with bilingual instruction, Youth STEM for Hispanic and low-income youth, and a 6-week Small Business Owner Training. Housing counseling workshops are free.
Summary_ES: Bread & Roses Housing, en asociación con CAF, ofrece varios programas. El Programa de Educación para Compradores de Vivienda ofrece un curso de 8 horas y asesoramiento individual para familias de ingresos bajos a moderados para comprar una casa. El Programa Local de Protección al Consumidor ayuda a los residentes de pueblos específicos a resolver disputas con empresas. El Programa Nueva Esperanza ofrece talleres virtuales semanales para personas mayores sobre salud e inglés. El Desarrollo de la Fuerza Laboral incluye Alfabetización Digital, capacitación para CDL Clase B con instrucción bilingüe, STEM para jóvenes hispanos y de bajos ingresos, y un Programa de Capacitación para Pequeños Empresarios de 6 semanas. Los talleres de asesoramiento de vivienda son gratuitos.

Name: Bread and Roses Kitchen
Summary_EN: Bread & Roses Community Kitchen offers free Emergency Food Pantry services, providing at least three days of groceries, diapers, toiletries, and other necessities for families and individuals. Free Community Meals (dinner) are available for dine-in or take-out. They also provide free pet food and walk-in medical services via the GLFHC Mobile Unit. One-on-one case management is offered in English and Spanish to help individuals and families access housing, employment, healthcare, and social services.
Summary_ES: La Cocina Comunitaria Bread & Roses ofrece servicios gratuitos de Despensa de Alimentos de Emergencia, proporcionando al menos tres días de comestibles, pañales, artículos de tocador y otras necesidades para familias e individuos. Hay Comidas Comunitarias (cena) gratuitas disponibles para llevar o comer en el lugar. También proporcionan comida para mascotas gratuita y servicios médicos sin cita previa a través de la Unidad Móvil GLFHC. Se ofrece gestión de casos individualizada en inglés y español para ayudar a individuos y familias a acceder a vivienda, empleo, atención médica y servicios sociales.
Programs: Emergency Food Pantry: Provides at least three days of groceries for households.; Community Meals: Free dinners, dine-in or take-out, served restaurant-style.; Diapers, Toiletries, and Other Basic Necessities: Provides diapers, toiletries, pet food, clothing, bedding.; Pet Food and Supplies: Provides free pet food.; Case Management: One-on-one assistance for housing, employment, healthcare, social services.; GLFHC Mobile Unit: Walk-in medical services.

Cost: Free

How_To_Start: Walk in during open hours; first come, first served for some services. Call if unable to come during set times for necessities.
Evidence: Bread & Roses offers free meals and groceries in Lawrence, MA to everyone in need, regardless of circumstances or location. || In tandem with our network of local agencies, we provide one-on-one case management in English and Spanish to assist individuals and families with accessing healthy food, obtaining housing, securing employment, health care and substance abuse treatment, and otherwise navigating social services more effectively.

Name: Community Giving Tree
Summary_EN: Community Giving Tree provides recycled clothing, baby equipment, and other basic necessities to families in need. These items are distributed through professionals working with non-profit organizations, schools, social service agencies, and health care centers. Goods are available to agents who serve families living in Essex County or Lowell, Massachusetts. The general public cannot visit the facility directly; only enrolled professionals can access these services for their clients.
Summary_ES: Community Giving Tree proporciona ropa reciclada, equipo para bebés y otras necesidades básicas a familias necesitadas. Estos artículos se distribuyen a través de profesionales que trabajan con organizaciones sin fines de lucro, escuelas, agencias de servicios sociales y centros de atención médica. Los artículos están disponibles para agentes que brindan servicios a familias que viven en el condado de Essex o Lowell, Massachusetts. El público en general no puede visitar las instalaciones directamente; solo los profesionales inscritos pueden acceder a estos servicios para sus clientes.

Who_It_Serves: Families in need living in Essex County or Lowell, Massachusetts, through enrolled professionals.

Hours_On_Site: Lawrence: Mon, Tues 9am-1pm Wed: 9am-5pm and Thurs: 9am-12pm

Name: Community InRoads
Summary_EN: Community InRoads offers consulting, training, and board development opportunities at no cost to nonprofit leaders and boards of directors in the Lawrence and Haverhill area. These services include customized Consulting, Executive Roundtables for networking, a Cultural Inclusion Program to diversify boards, Board Tune Up for effective governance, and free Workshops on nonprofit management. Nonprofits receive support to better serve community residents.

Estos servicios incluyen Consultoría personalizada, Mesas Redondas Ejecutivas para establecer contactos, un Programa de Inclusión Cultural para diversificar las juntas, Ajuste de Juntas para una gobernanza efectiva y Talleres gratuitos sobre gestión de organizaciones sin fines de lucro. Name: Greater Lawrence Community Action Council (GLCAC)
Summary_EN: Greater Lawrence Community Action Council offers Head Start for children aged 15 months to 5 years in Lawrence and Methuen. They help eligible Massachusetts residents aged 18-64 apply for the MBTA Income-Eligible Reduced Fares Program. The Community Service Center provides help with housing, notarizations, health referrals, and applications for individuals and families whose household income is 125% of federal poverty standards. Free energy conservation programs, including heating system repairs and weatherization, are available for qualifying low-income households, and the Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Program offers case management and education.
Summary_ES: Greater Lawrence Community Action Council ofrece Head Start para niños de 15 meses a 5 años en Lawrence y Methuen. Ayudan a residentes elegibles de Massachusetts de 18 a 64 años a solicitar el Programa de Tarifas Reducidas para MBTA Elegibles por Ingresos. El Centro de Servicio Comunitario brinda ayuda con vivienda, notarizaciones, referencias de salud y solicitudes para individuos y familias cuyo ingreso familiar es el 125% de los estándares federales de pobreza. Hay programas gratuitos de conservación de energía, incluyendo reparaciones de sistemas de calefacción y climatización, disponibles para hogares de bajos ingresos que califiquen, y el Programa de Prevención de Envenenamiento por Plomo en la Infancia ofrece gestión de casos y educación.
Programs: Head Start: Early learning for children 15 months to 5 years.; MBTA Income-Eligible Reduced Fares Program: Help applying for half-price transit fares.; Community Service Center: Help with housing, notarizations, health, applications.; Immigration Legal Services: Legal assistance for immigration matters.; ESOL classes: English language instruction.; Energy Services Program: Fix heating systems, weatherize homes, energy audits.; HEARTWAP (Heating Retrofit): Free heating system repair or replacement.; Weatherization Assistance Program: Free home weatherization and repairs.; Utility Company Conservation Programs: Free electricity audits and energy materials.; Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Program: Case management and education on lead.

Cost: Free
How_To_Start: Contact the appropriate program.
Evidence: Head Start Now Enrolling - All ages (15 months to 5 years) - Five convenient locations in Lawrence and Methuen || The Community Service Center helps individuals & families with a variety of common – and uncommon – challenges.
Hours_In_Dashboard: Mon–Fri 8:30 AM–4:30 PM (admin office; program hours vary by department)

Name: Greater Lawrence Family Health
Summary_EN: Greater Lawrence Family Health Center offers Primary Care for children and adults, including prenatal, pediatric, elderly, and women's health services. They provide confidential, no-cost testing for STIs, HIV, and Viral Hepatitis, plus Office-Based Addiction Treatment for opioid use disorder. Services also include Healthcare for the Homeless, School-Based Health Centers for students, and pharmacies with free delivery. A Sliding Fee Payment Scale is available for health insurance enrollment assistance, and Spanish-speaking staff are available.

Los servicios también incluyen Atención Médica para Personas sin Hogar, Centros de Salud Escolares para estudiantes y farmacias con entrega gratuita. Una Escala Móvil de Pagos está disponible para asistencia con la inscripción al seguro médico, y cuentan con personal que habla español.

Name: Greater Lawrence Fellowship of the Arts
Summary_EN: Greater Lawrence Fellowship of the Arts offers the Mindful Arts Summer Institute, a free summer program in Methuen. It also provides a MINDFUL ARTS PROGRAM with 12-week sessions in Dance/Movement, Music, Creative Writing, Visual Art, and Theater/Playwriting. These programs help students find their voice through expressive arts and offer tools like journaling and breathwork to process challenges. Students showcase their creativity at the end of each session.
Summary_ES: Greater Lawrence Fellowship of the Arts ofrece el Mindful Arts Summer Institute, un programa gratuito de verano en Methuen. También ofrece un MINDFUL ARTS PROGRAM con sesiones de 12 semanas en Danza/Movimiento, Música, Escritura Creativa, Arte Visual y Teatro/Dramaturgia. Estos programas ayudan a los estudiantes a encontrar su voz a través de las artes expresivas y ofrecen herramientas como el diario y ejercicios de respiración para procesar desafíos. Los estudiantes muestran su creatividad al final de cada sesión.

Name: Greater Lawrence Technical School
Summary_EN: Greater Lawrence Technical School offers career and technical training for students from Andover, Lawrence, Methuen, and North Andover. Name: International Institute of Greater Lawrence

Name: Lawrence Boys and Girls Club
Summary_EN: The Lawrence Boys & Girls Club offers programs for young people of Greater Lawrence. "Planning for Your Future" helps high schoolers apply to college, military, or trades, and middle schoolers plan for high school. They also provide academic support, promote healthy lifestyles, and offer character and leadership development. Name: Lawrence Catholic Academy
Summary_EN: Lawrence Catholic Academy offers a Catholic School education and a challenging academic program for children aged three through grade eight. The Merrimack Valley Small Business Coalition supports small businesses, primarily minority-owned, across the Merrimack Valley.

La Coalición de Pequeñas Empresas de Merrimack Valley apoya a pequeñas empresas, principalmente propiedad de minorías, en todo el Valle de Merrimack.

Name: Lawrence Prospera- Quintana Center
Summary_EN: The Maria del Pilar Quintana Family Center offers Citizenship and ESL classes for Lawrence’s immigrant population. It also provides assistance with the Naturalization process, Green Card renewal, Fee Waivers, and Change of Address. Each year, the center registers over 500 students who want to improve their literacy skills and community engagement.
Summary_ES: El Centro Familiar María del Pilar Quintana ofrece clases de Ciudadanía e Inglés como Segundo Idioma (ESL) para la población inmigrante de Lawrence. También brinda asistencia con el proceso de Naturalización, renovación de la Tarjeta Verde, exenciones de tarifas y cambios de dirección. Cada año, el centro inscribe a más de 500 estudiantes que buscan mejorar sus habilidades de alfabetización y participación comunitaria.
Programs: ESL Program: English as a Second Language classes; Citizenship Naturalization Services: Help with naturalization process; Naturalization process assistance: Support for citizenship applications; Green Card renewal: Help renewing Green Cards; Fee Waivers: Assistance applying for fee waivers; Change of Address: Help with immigration address changes; Adult Education: Programming focused on asset building
Who_It_Serves: residents of the City of Lawrence, specifically Lawrence’s immigrant population
Evidence: In 1998, the Maria del Pilar Quintana Family Center opened its doors to Lawrence’s immigrant population. || Helping to achieve the goals of assimilation and citizenship, the Quintana center provides Citizenship and ESL classes.

Name: Lawrence Public Library
Summary_EN: The Lawrence Public Library offers services for all ages, including books, e-books, and digital resources in English, Spanish, and other languages. Children's Services provides books, homework help, computers, storytimes, and activities for babies through school-age children. Teen Services offers books, study spaces, computers, games, and community service opportunities for teens in grades 7-12. The library also provides Notary Services to the public, community resource referrals, and assistance with research, citizenship, and government information.
Summary_ES: La Biblioteca Pública de Lawrence ofrece servicios para todas las edades, incluyendo libros, libros electrónicos y recursos digitales en inglés, español y otros idiomas. Los Servicios para Niños proporcionan libros, ayuda con las tareas, computadoras, horas de cuentos y actividades para bebés hasta niños en edad escolar. Los Servicios para Adolescentes ofrecen libros, espacios de estudio, computadoras, juegos y oportunidades de servicio comunitario para adolescentes de 7º a 12º grado. La biblioteca también brinda Servicios Notariales al público, referencias a recursos comunitarios y asistencia con investigación, ciudadanía e información gubernamental.
Programs: Borrow E-Books, E-Audiobooks, Music, & More: Access digital and physical media.; Notary Services: In-person notarization for public documents.; Community Resources: Referrals for housing, food, health care.; Children's Services: Books, homework help, activities for kids.; Teen Services: Books, study space, activities for teens.; Spanish Collection & Multilingual Resources: Materials in Spanish and other languages.; Information Services: Research, citizenship, government information assistance.; Computers & Technology: Public access to computers and digital tools.; Reserve Museum Passes: Discounted entry to local museums.; Library Card: Get or renew a library card.; Events: Author talks, storytimes, clubs, games.; Homework Assistance: Support for school assignments.

Evidence: Discover books, audiobooks, movies, magazines, newspapers, and digital resources in Spanish and other languages. || Reference & Information Services connects you with reliable information, Library resources, and personalized assistance for research, learning, and everyday needs.
Hours_In_Dashboard: Mon–Thu 9 AM–9 PM; Fri–Sat 9 AM–5 PM; Sun closed

Name: Lazarus House Ministries
Summary_EN: Lazarus House Ministries offers a Food Pantry for supplemental groceries and a Soup Kitchen for daily breakfast and lunch. The Thrift Store provides affordable clothing and household items, with vouchers for urgent needs. The Emergency Shelter offers a safe place for single women and children. Capernaum Place and Casa Bethesda provide transitional housing with programs for goal setting and employment. Guest Services offers information on medical, housing, career services, and personal care items. Advocacy helps Guests navigate systems and connect to resources.
Summary_ES: Lazarus House Ministries ofrece una Despensa de Alimentos para comestibles suplementarios y un Comedor Social para desayuno y almuerzo diarios. La Tienda de Segunda Mano ofrece ropa y artículos para el hogar asequibles, con vales para necesidades urgentes. El Refugio de Emergencia proporciona un lugar seguro para mujeres solteras y niños. Capernaum Place y Casa Bethesda ofrecen vivienda de transición con programas para establecer metas y preparación para el empleo. Los Servicios para Huéspedes ofrecen información sobre servicios médicos, de vivienda, profesionales y artículos de cuidado personal. La Abogacía ayuda a los Huéspedes a navegar sistemas y conectarse con recursos.
Programs: Food Pantry: Distributes supplemental groceries to individuals and families.; Soup Kitchen: Serves daily breakfast and lunch meals.; Thrift Store: Offers affordable clothing and household items.; Emergency Shelter: Provides shelter for single women and children.; Capernaum Place: Transitional housing with programs for individuals and families.; Casa Bethesda: Transitional housing with programs for individuals and families.; Guest Services: Provides information and personal care items.; Advocacy: Helps Guests navigate systems and find resources.
Who_It_Serves: individuals and families in Lawrence, MA and the Merrimack Valley facing homelessness and food insecurity.
Cost: Thrift Store offers affordable items; some partner services are free.
Evidence: Lazarus House is a community-based nonprofit in Lawrence, MA, serving 2,000 individuals and families each week who are facing the challenges of homelessness and food insecurity. || In 2025, dozens of Guests were provided a place to stay in our Shelter and longer-term Transitional Housing, 13 seasonal emergency response nights were held due to extreme weather conditions, more than 70,000 meals were served in the Soup Kitchen, and nearly 85,000 bags of supplemental groceries were distributed at the Food Pantry.
Hours_In_Dashboard: Soup kitchen: daily 8:30–9:30 AM & 11:30 AM–1 PM; Food pantry: Wed 9 AM–2 PM; Thrift store: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 10 AM–3 PM; Wed 9 AM–5 PM

Name: Merrimack River Watershed Council (MRVC)
Summary_EN: The Merrimack River Watershed Council collects water quality data along the Merrimack River, focusing on bacteria levels to determine if the water is safe for recreation like swimming or boating. Residents can explore interactive dashboards and download annual reports to learn about water quality findings. The council also accepts volunteers for its Water Quality Monitoring Program.
Summary_ES: El Merrimack River Watershed Council recopila datos de calidad del agua a lo largo del río Merrimack, centrándose en los niveles de bacterias para determinar si el agua es segura para actividades recreativas como nadar o pasear en bote. Los residentes pueden explorar paneles interactivos y descargar informes anuales para conocer los hallazgos sobre la calidad del agua. El consejo también acepta voluntarios para su programa de monitoreo de la calidad del agua.
Programs: Water Quality Monitoring Program: Collects data on river health for recreation; Interactive dashboards: Provide public access to water quality data; Annual Reports: Detailed reports on water quality findings; Volunteer community scientists: Collect water quality monitoring data
Who_It_Serves: People who use the Merrimack River for recreation and residents of the Merrimack River Watershed
How_To_Start: Explore interactive dashboards or download annual reports
Evidence: MRWC collects water quality data at sites along the main stem of the Merrimack River, from Manchester, NH to Newburyport and Salisbury, MA. || We use those guidelines in our program to categorize the bacteria concentrations we measure as “safe” or “unsafe” for recreation.

Name: Merrimack Valley Food Bank
Summary_EN: Merrimack Valley Food Bank offers several food programs. SNAP Outreach & Enrollment provides free help applying for food benefits. The Community Market gives free fresh produce and staples to residents of specific housing properties in Lowell, Chelmsford, Dracut, Billerica, and Tewksbury. Children 18 and under in Lowell get free summer lunches and snacks. The Mobile Pantry delivers monthly groceries to homebound elderly and disabled individuals in Greater Lowell. Operation Nourish provides supplemental food to students in Lowell and Lawrence schools.
Summary_ES: Merrimack Valley Food Bank ofrece varios programas de alimentos. SNAP Outreach & Enrollment brinda ayuda gratuita para solicitar beneficios de alimentos. El Community Market ofrece frutas y verduras frescas y productos básicos gratis a residentes de propiedades de vivienda específicas en Lowell, Chelmsford, Dracut, Billerica y Tewksbury. Niños de 18 años o menos en Lowell reciben almuerzos y meriendas gratis en verano. El Mobile Pantry entrega comestibles mensuales a personas mayores y discapacitadas confinadas en casa en Greater Lowell. Operation Nourish proporciona alimentos suplementarios a estudiantes en escuelas de Lowell y Lawrence.
Programs: SNAP Outreach & Enrollment: Helps individuals and families apply for food benefits.; Community Market: Free farmer’s market style food distribution for residents.; Summer Eats: Provides healthy lunches and snacks to children in need.; Mobile Pantry: Delivers monthly groceries to homebound elderly and disabled.; Operation Nourish: Provides supplemental food to students in schools.; Food Distribution: Distributes food to a network of member agencies.; Food Rescue: Picks up perishable foods from supermarkets for distribution.
Who_It_Serves: Individuals, families, children, homebound elderly, disabled, and students in Greater Lowell, Lawrence, and specific housing properties.
Cost: free
How_To_Start: Call or fill out form for assistance.
Evidence: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)—formerly known as food stamps—is a federal nutrition program that helps individuals and families buy healthy food every month. || Our Community Market program is a free farmer’s market style food distribution serving the residents of five Lowell Housing Authority properties, Chelmsford Senior Housing, Dracut Senior Housing, Billerica Greenwood Complex and Tewksbury Carnation Drive.

Reviewer_Notes: Accurate to the site but most programs listed are for Lowell-area residents. Lead with what Lawrence residents can use (Operation Nourish in Lawrence schools, SNAP help).

Name: MSPCC/Healthy Families
Summary_EN: MSPCC/Healthy Families offers a free home-based family coaching program for first-time parents in Andover, Lawrence, Methuen, Middleton, and North Andover. It supports parents during pregnancy and the child’s first three years, teaching baby care, parenting skills, and healthy child development. Home visitors also help parents achieve personal goals like schooling or housing. Services are available in English and Spanish.
Summary_ES: MSPCC/Healthy Families ofrece un programa gratuito de coaching familiar a domicilio para padres primerizos en Andover, Lawrence, Methuen, Middleton y North Andover. Apoya a los padres durante el embarazo y los primeros tres años del niño, enseñando el cuidado del bebé, habilidades parentales y desarrollo infantil saludable. Los visitantes a domicilio también ayudan a los padres a alcanzar metas personales como la educación o la vivienda. Los servicios están disponibles en inglés y español.
Programs: Healthy Families: Home-based coaching for first-time parents.; Pregnancy and Parenting Support: Assistance for expectant and new parents.; Child and Family Counseling: Mental health support for children and families.; Foster Care and Adoption: Support and services for foster and adoptive parents.
Who_It_Serves: First-time parents who are pregnant or have a child under age 1.
Cost: free
How_To_Start: Make a referral
Evidence: Healthy Families is a voluntary and free home-based family coaching program that supports first-time parents and helps them create stable, nurturing environments for their children. || The program matches parents with trained professionals who visit families’ homes to provide support during pregnancy and the child’s first three years of life.

Name: Neighbors in Need
Summary_EN: Neighbors In Need offers mobile market food pantries providing groceries, fresh produce, and other basic necessities to anyone experiencing food insecurity. They also operate a diaper pantry, distributing diapers and supplies for infants whose families live in Andover, Haverhill, Lawrence, Methuen, or North Andover. Services are free, and staff can assist Spanish and Mandarin-speaking clients. They also provide holiday meal boxes and home deliveries for some families.
Summary_ES: Neighbors In Need ofrece mobile market food pantries que proporcionan comestibles, productos frescos y otras necesidades básicas a cualquier persona que experimente inseguridad alimentaria. También operan un diaper pantry, distribuyendo pañales y suministros para bebés cuyas familias viven en Andover, Haverhill, Lawrence, Methuen o North Andover. Los servicios son gratuitos y el personal puede ayudar a clientes que hablan español y mandarín. También ofrecen cajas de comidas festivas y entregas a domicilio para algunas familias.

Name: Northern Essex Community College
Summary_EN: Northern Essex Community College offers academic programs including Associate Degrees and Certificate programs, available online, in-person, and hybrid. Eligible Massachusetts residents can receive Free Community College, which covers tuition, fees, books, and supplies. The college also provides an American Sign Language Studies Associate Degree and a Sign Language Interpreting Certificate. Students can access free tutoring services and technical support for their courses.
Summary_ES: Northern Essex Community College ofrece programas académicos que incluyen títulos de asociado y programas de certificado, disponibles en línea, presenciales e híbridos. Los residentes elegibles de Massachusetts pueden acceder a la Universidad Comunitaria Gratuita, que cubre la matrícula, tarifas, libros y materiales. La universidad también ofrece un Título Asociado en Estudios de Lenguaje de Señas Americano y un Certificado de Interpretación de Lenguaje de Señas. Los estudiantes pueden acceder a servicios de tutoría y soporte técnico gratuitos para sus cursos.

ThinkingStorm is offered to NECC students at no additional cost.

Name: Notre Dame Cristo Rey
Summary_EN: Notre Dame Cristo Rey High School is a private, Catholic, college-preparatory school for underserved youth and students from families with limited income. It offers rigorous academics combined with a Corporate Work Study Program where students work five days a month to cover most of their education costs. Students can also take college courses through Dual Enrollment. Alumni can access financial, academic, and transition support, including an Alumni Emergency Fund for those pursuing higher education who experience unexpected financial changes.
Summary_ES: La Escuela Preparatoria Católica Notre Dame Cristo Rey es para jóvenes desatendidos y estudiantes de familias con ingresos limitados. Ofrece una educación preparatoria para la universidad con un riguroso programa académico y un Programa de Estudio de Trabajo Corporativo donde los estudiantes trabajan cinco días al mes para cubrir la mayor parte de los costos de su educación. Los estudiantes también pueden tomar cursos universitarios a través de la Inscripción Dual. Los exalumnos pueden acceder a apoyo financiero, académico y de transición, incluyendo un Fondo de Emergencia para Exalumnos para aquellos que cursan estudios superiores y experimentan cambios financieros inesperados.
Programs: Corporate Work Study Program (CWSP): Students work to cover education costs; Dual Enrollment: High school students take college courses for credit; Alumni Resources: Support for college, career, and life after graduation; Sister Mary Murphy Alumni Emergency Fund: Financial aid for alumni at risk of discontinuing studies; College advising and counseling: Academic and financial aid support for alumni; Social Emotional Support: For alumni experiencing college transition difficulties; Community Service: Juniors complete 15 hours of service
Who_It_Serves: Underserved youth, students from families with limited income, and NDCR alumni pursuing higher education
Cost: Students cover the majority of education costs through a work-study program; alumni emergency fund available
How_To_Start: Contact your NDCR Alumni Counselor; apply online for the Alumni Emergency Fund
Evidence: Notre Dame Cristo Rey High School is a private, Catholic, college-preparatory school serving 290 underserved youth. || Through the CWSP, each student works five full days per month during the academic year at one of more than 75 companies across the Merrimack Valley, the I-93/495 corridors, and southern New Hampshire.

Name: Partners for Child Development
Summary_EN: Partners for Child Development offers Early Intervention Services for children ages 0-3 with developmental delays or at risk for delays. These services are provided at no cost to families in specific MA towns. The Anderson School serves students ages 3-16 with complex medical needs in Andover, and Woodbridge School is an early childhood education program for children 18 months to 5 years old, also in Andover.
Summary_ES: Partners for Child Development ofrece Servicios de Intervención Temprana para niños de 0 a 3 años con retrasos en el desarrollo o en riesgo de tenerlos. Estos servicios se proporcionan sin costo para las familias en ciertas ciudades de MA. La Anderson School atiende a estudiantes de 3 a 16 años con necesidades médicas complejas en Andover, y Woodbridge School es un programa de educación infantil temprana para niños de 18 meses a 5 años, también en Andover.
Programs: Early Intervention Services: therapeutic program for children 0-3 with developmental delays; Anderson School: special education school for students 3-16 with complex needs; Woodbridge School: early childhood education for children 18 months to 5 years
Who_It_Serves: Children ages 0-16 and their families in Andover, North Andover, Lawrence, Methuen, Billerica, Chelmsford, Dracut, Dunstable, Lowell, Tewksbury, Tyngsborough, Westford

How_To_Start: Call to inquire or refer a child
Evidence: Our program dramatically improves outcomes for children ages 0-3 who have developmental delays or are at risk for delays. || Services are provided at no cost to the family through therapeutic interventions embedded in their daily routines.

Name: Phoenix Charter Academy
Summary_EN: Phoenix Charter Academy offers a free, open-enrollment public charter high school experience. Students can prepare for college and professional careers. This includes dual-enrollment opportunities with local community colleges and career pathways like healthcare certifications. It serves high school students from across Massachusetts, including Lawrence, Haverhill, Methuen, and Lowell, many of whom are over 18.
Summary_ES: Phoenix Charter Academy ofrece una experiencia de escuela secundaria pública chárter gratuita y de inscripción abierta. Los estudiantes pueden prepararse para la universidad y carreras profesionales. Esto incluye oportunidades de doble inscripción con colegios comunitarios locales y trayectorias profesionales como certificaciones de atención médica. Sirve a estudiantes de secundaria de todo Massachusetts, incluyendo Lawrence, Haverhill, Methuen y Lowell, muchos de los cuales tienen más de 18 años.
Programs: Phoenix Charter Academy: Free public charter high school experience.; Dual-enrollment opportunities: College courses while still in high school.; Career pathway in Chelsea: Healthcare certifications for career readiness.
Who_It_Serves: High school students from Massachusetts, including Lawrence, Haverhill, Methuen, and Lowell, many over 18.
Cost: Free
How_To_Start: Apply online, via mail, or in person.
Evidence: Phoenix Charter Academy provides high-quality alternative education at three high schools across Massachusetts. || Our free and open-enrollment schools were built to help you prepare for both college and an exciting professional career.

Name: Sevita Health
Summary_EN: Sevita Health offers Residential and Periodic Services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. They provide Specialized Healthcare for all ages with neurological injuries or complex needs. For children and families, services include Foster Care, Family Behavioral Health Services, Juvenile Justice Services, and Day Treatment for behavioral challenges and autism. They also offer Children’s Transition Supports for youth with disabilities and Early Intervention Services for young children with developmental delays. Services help individuals live independently and build skills.
Summary_ES: Sevita Health ofrece Servicios Residenciales y Periódicos para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo. Proporcionan Atención Médica Especializada para todas las edades con lesiones neurológicas o necesidades complejas. Para niños y familias, los servicios incluyen Servicios de Cuidado de Crianza, Servicios de Salud Conductual Familiar, Servicios de Justicia Juvenil y Tratamiento Diurno para desafíos conductuales y autismo. También ofrecen Apoyos de Transición para Jóvenes con discapacidades y Servicios de Intervención Temprana para niños pequeños con retrasos en el desarrollo. Los servicios ayudan a las personas a vivir de forma independiente y desarrollar habilidades.

Evidence: Sevita's services support growth and independence in every stage of life. || Our programs help people with intellectual and developmental disabilities, medical needs, and other challenges reach their full potential.

Name: Si se puede!
Summary_EN: Si, Se Puede! offers three main programs. The SSP AFTER SCHOOL program provides homework help, workshops, and extracurricular activities for students. The SSP Teen center helps high school students develop leadership skills, improve academic performance, and foster personal growth through workshops and mentoring. The SSP summer program prevents learning loss and promotes personal growth for young minds through on-site education and off-site field trips.
Summary_ES: ¡Si, Se Puede! ofrece tres programas principales. El programa SSP AFTER SCHOOL brinda ayuda con la tarea, talleres y actividades extracurriculares para estudiantes. El SSP Teen center ayuda a los estudiantes de secundaria a desarrollar habilidades de liderazgo, mejorar el rendimiento académico y fomentar el crecimiento personal a través de talleres y tutorías. El programa SSP summer previene la pérdida de aprendizaje y promueve el crecimiento personal para mentes jóvenes mediante educación en el sitio y excursiones.

Who_It_Serves: low-income urban youth and their families in Lawrence, MA
Evidence: The program provides a secure environment for students to receive educational support, including homework help, skill-building workshops, and tailored extracurricular activities that cater to their individual needs. || The center caters to high school students aiming to enhance leadership skills, academic performance, and personal growth through workshops, mentoring, and hands-on projects that prepare them for future success.

Name: Squash Busters
Summary_EN: SquashBusters offers programs for public school students in Lawrence, Boston, and Providence, from middle school through college graduation. These include College-Readiness, Access and Success with homework help, SAT prep, and college mentoring; Leadership & Character Development through community service and summer experiences; and Health and Wellness with squash practice, fitness, and social-emotional support including mental health counseling. Students receive academic support, leadership opportunities, and physical and mental health resources.
Summary_ES: SquashBusters ofrece programas para estudiantes de escuelas públicas en Lawrence, Boston y Providence, desde la escuela intermedia hasta la graduación universitaria. Los estudiantes reciben apoyo académico, oportunidades de liderazgo y recursos de salud física y mental.
Programs: College-Readiness, Access and Success: Homework help, SAT prep, college mentoring, application support; Leadership & Character Development: Community service, leadership opportunities, summer experiences; Health and Wellness: Squash practice, fitness activities, social-emotional support, counseling; Middle School Program: Tutoring, high school placement, college visits; High School Program: Homework support, college-readiness workshops, SAT prep, college application help; College Support: Guidance, financial aid assistance, scholarship opportunities; Community Service Projects: Volunteering, giving back to communities; Leadership Development: Student Ambassadors, Team Captains, mentoring younger students; Summer Engagement: Internal programs, brokered opportunities, internships, camps; Squash and Fitness: Regular practice, competitions, fitness assessments; Social-Emotional Health: Discussion groups, mental health counseling, mentoring
