Evidence: SquashBusters provides our students – the majority of whom will be the first in their family to attend college – with a long-term pathway to a college degree. || Through regular practice, squash competitions, and fitness activities, students learn the importance of health and wellness for life.

Name: The Community Builders
Summary_EN: The Community Builders offers real estate and Community Life initiatives. These include keeping housing affordable, connecting new parents to childcare, ensuring residents have access to nutritious food, and bridging the digital divide. Services are for residents in low-income communities, aiming to create stable homes and economic opportunities. The organization also focuses on residential and commercial development and property management.
Summary_ES: The Community Builders ofrece iniciativas de bienes raíces y de Vida Comunitaria. Estas incluyen mantener la vivienda asequible, conectar a nuevos padres con cuidado infantil, asegurar que los residentes tengan acceso a alimentos nutritivos y cerrar la brecha digital. Los servicios son para residentes en comunidades de bajos ingresos, con el objetivo de crear hogares estables y oportunidades económicas. La organización también se enfoca en el desarrollo residencial y comercial, y la gestión de propiedades.
Programs: Residential & Commercial Development: Creating better places to live; Property & Asset Management: Placing residents at the center; Community Life initiatives: Connecting people with equitable opportunities; Affordable Housing: Keeping housing affordable; Childcare Connections: Connecting new parents to childcare; Nutritious Food Access: Ensuring residents have access to nutritious food; Digital Divide Bridging: Bridging the digital divide for residents
Who_It_Serves: All people, especially residents in low income communities
How_To_Start: Reach out via phone or email, or by filling out the contact form
Evidence: As a non-profit organization, our real estate and Community Life initiatives transform neighborhoods and impact lives. || Whether it’s connecting new parents to childcare, ensuring residents have access to nutritious food or bridging the digital divide for residents in low income communities, your commitment to centering residents, their needs and their experiences in all that you do is inspiring and so necessary.”

Name: The Community Group
Summary_EN: The Community Group offers Early Learning Education for children from infancy to school age, and Community Kids Place for out-of-school time enrichment for school-aged children. It also runs the Community Day Charter Public School for K1-8 students in Lawrence, MA. The Child Care Circuit provides child care referrals and resources for families and providers.
Summary_ES: The Community Group ofrece Early Learning Education para niños desde la infancia hasta la edad escolar, y Community Kids Place para enriquecimiento fuera del horario escolar para niños en edad escolar. También opera la Community Day Charter Public School para estudiantes de K1-8 en Lawrence, MA. El Child Care Circuit brinda referencias y recursos de cuidado infantil para familias y proveedores.
Programs: Early Learning Education: Education and care for children from infancy to school age.; Community Kids Place: Out-of-school time enrichment for school aged children.; Training and Workforce Development: Coaching, support, and training for child care professionals.; Child Care Circuit: Child care referrals and resources for families and providers.; Community Day Charter Public School: K1-8 Charter Public School in Lawrence, MA.
Who_It_Serves: children and families, child care professionals, and providers in Lawrence, MA
Evidence: Education and care for children from infancy to school age || Out-of-school time enrichment for school aged children

Name: The Kindness Collaborative
Summary_EN: The Kindness Collaborative provides acts of kindness and support to residents in the Merrimack Valley. Through its C.A.R.E. program, it delivers Kindness Packages, Sympathy & Support Baskets, Chemo Support Packs, and necessities like clothes and food. The FEED THE NEED program offers grocery support, meal trains, bagged lunches for the homeless, and soup kitchen meal support. Services are for individuals and families who need kindness or support.
Summary_ES: The Kindness Collaborative ofrece actos de bondad y apoyo a los residentes del Valle de Merrimack. A través de su programa C.A.R.E., entrega Paquetes de Bondad, Cestas de Apoyo y Simpatía, Paquetes de Apoyo para Quimioterapia y necesidades como ropa y alimentos. El programa FEED THE NEED ofrece apoyo con comestibles, trenes de comidas, almuerzos empaquetados para personas sin hogar y apoyo de comidas para comedores comunitarios. Los servicios son para individuos y familias que necesitan bondad o apoyo.
Programs: C.A.R.E. (Community. Action. Response. Engagement.): Delivers kindness packages, support baskets, necessities.; FEED THE NEED: Provides food support, meals, groceries for those in need.; KINDNESS MEDIA: Spreads kindness and community information through video.; KINDNESS IN MOTION: Organizes volunteering activities, workshops, and classes.; BUSINESS TOGETHER: Connects businesses for community kindness initiatives.
Who_It_Serves: Residents of the Merrimack Valley, including individuals and families in need.
Evidence: C.A.R.E. is the foundation of who we are as an organization – it is simply finding out about someone who could use some kindness and bringing it to them. || The Feed the Need Program allows us to spread kindness and support through the power of food!

Name: The Salvation Army Lawrence Corps
Summary_EN: The Salvation Army Lawrence Corps offers a Food Pantry for families: Wednesdays for families of 3+ individuals and Thursdays for families of 1-2 individuals. They also provide Camp and Summer Programs for children from low-income families, offering activities like swimming, arts, and sports. Office & Social Services are available Monday-Thursday, and Children's Programs run on Wednesdays and Thursdays.
Summary_ES: The Salvation Army Lawrence Corps ofrece una Despensa de Alimentos (Food Pantry) para familias: los miércoles para familias de 3+ individuos y los jueves para familias de 1-2 individuos. También ofrecen Camp and Summer Programs para niños de familias de bajos ingresos, con actividades como natación, arte y deportes. Los Office & Social Services están disponibles de lunes a jueves, y los Children's Programs los miércoles y jueves.
Programs: Food Pantry: Provides groceries to families.; Camp and Summer Programs: Offers summer camp experiences for children.; Thanksgiving and Christmas Assistance: Provides holiday help.; Office & Social Services: Offers general assistance and support.; Children's Programs: Provides activities for children.
Who_It_Serves: Individuals and families, especially those in low-income communities, and children.
How_To_Start: Visit during office hours or call for information.
Evidence: The Salvation Army provides year-round programs to help individuals and families in low-income communities thrive. || Food Pantry: Wednesdays: 9:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m. | families of 3+ individuals Thursdays: 9:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m. | families 1-2 individuals
Hours_On_Site: Office & Social Services: Monday-Thursday | 9:00 a.m. - 2:00 p.m. Children's Programs: Wednesdays and Thursday | 4:00 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. Food Pantry: Wednesdays: 9:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m. | families of 3+ individuals Thursdays: 9:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m. | families 1-2 individuals
Hours_In_Dashboard: Office & social services: Mon–Thu 9 AM–2 PM; Food pantry: Wed 9 AM–1 PM (families of 3+), Thu 9–11 AM (families of 1–2)

Name: Youth Development Organization
Summary_EN: Youth Development Organization offers classes in strings, 3D design, meditation & journaling, biology, and tools & building for students in Grades 3 and up. It also provides Postsecondary Pathways for college applications and essays, and theater productions like ydshow. The afterschool program is free for Lawrence residents; a minimal fee may apply for the five-week YDO Summer program, which can be waived for families in need. YDO serves over 700 students from Lawrence and neighboring communities.
Summary_ES: Youth Development Organization ofrece clases de cuerdas, diseño 3D, meditación y diario, biología, y herramientas y construcción para estudiantes de 3er grado en adelante. También ofrece Postsecondary Pathways para solicitudes y ensayos universitarios, y producciones teatrales como ydshow. El programa después de la escuela es gratuito para los residentes de Lawrence; puede aplicarse una tarifa mínima para el programa de verano YDO de cinco semanas, que puede ser eximida para familias necesitadas. YDO atiende a más de 700 estudiantes de Lawrence y comunidades vecinas.
Programs: strings classes: Music instruction; 3D design classes: Design and technology instruction; meditation & journaling classes: Mindfulness and writing; biology classes: Science education; tools & building classes: Hands-on construction skills; Postsecondary Pathways: College application and essay help; ydshow: Theater production; Advisory Services: Guidance and support; Arts: Creative and performing arts; STEM: Science, Technology, Engineering, Math; YDO @Phillips Academy: Programs at Phillips Academy; YDO Summer: Five-week summer program
Who_It_Serves: Students in Grades 3 and up from Lawrence and neighboring communities; afterschool program is free for Lawrence residents.
Cost: Afterschool program is free for Lawrence residents. Families from neighboring communities are asked to make donations. A minimal registration fee may apply for the five-week YDO Summer program, which can be waived for families in need. A small weekly fee for transportation, which can be waived for families in need.
How_To_Start: Contact Nelly Alba to schedule a tour/interview.
Evidence: Our students are diving into classes like strings, 3D design, meditation & journaling, biology, tools & building, and so much more. || Our afterschool program is free for Lawrence residents.
